Conduit
ConduitBehaviour

Base class that inherits MonoBehaviour to register Network handlers and automatically unregister them upon OnDestroy. Supports both attribute-based automatic registration and manual method registration.

ConduitConfig

Global configuration for Conduit. Must be set before calling Init. 'serverUrl' and 'stunServers' are required.

Conduit<TLobbyState, TUserProfile, TAccountState>

Typed accessor for Conduit. Use with a using alias for convenience:

using Net = ConduitNet.Conduit<MyLobbyState, MyProfile, MyAccount>;

Then access typed properties directly: Net.LocalUser.Profile, Net.Lobby.State
